=== create src/controllers/pages/profile.rs
//! `GET /people/{handle}`: the profile page. Generated by `cargo offrails generate page profile`.

use axum::{
    extract::Path,
    response::{IntoResponse, Response},
};

use crate::error::AppError;
use crate::views::{self, Ctx, pages::profile::PagesProfile};

/// `GET /people/{handle}`
#[tracing::instrument(skip_all)]
pub async fn show(
    ctx: Ctx,
    Path(handle): Path<String>,
) -> Result<Response, AppError> {
    // APP: a description for search results and link previews: ctx.described("…").
    Ok(views::render(PagesProfile {
        ctx: ctx.titled("Profile"),
        handle,
    })?
    .into_response())
}

=== create src/views/pages/profile.rs
//! The profile page's struct. Generated by `cargo offrails generate page profile`.

use askama::Template;

use crate::views::Ctx;
// The layout links with `paths::`.
use crate::routes::paths;

/// `GET /people/{handle}`
#[derive(Template)]
#[template(path = "pages/profile.html")]
pub struct PagesProfile {
    pub ctx: Ctx,
    /// From the path (`{handle}`): untrusted; Askama escapes it.
    pub handle: String,
}

=== create templates/pages/profile.html
{% extends "layouts/application.html" %}
{% import "components/ui.html" as ui %}
{% block content %}
{% call ui::page_header("Profile") %}{% endcall %}
<p>APP: the profile page's words for <code>{{ handle }}</code> (templates/pages/profile.html).</p>
{% endblock %}

=== create src/routes/profile.rs
//! The profile page (`cargo offrails generate page profile`): its router, `paths::` helpers and `ROUTES` rows.
//! src/routes.rs wires it in with one `// profile` line at `route mods`, `routes`, `paths`, `route tables`.

use axum::{Router, routing::get};

use super::{Access, Route};
use crate::state::AppState;

pub fn router() -> Router<AppState> {
    Router::new()
        .route("/people/{handle}", get(crate::controllers::pages::profile::show))
}

/// URL helpers; `crate::routes::paths` re-exports them.
pub mod paths {
    pub fn profile(handle: &str) -> String {
        format!("/people/{handle}")
    }
}

#[rustfmt::skip]
pub const ROUTES: &[Route] = &[
    ("GET",  "/people/{handle}", "pages::profile::show", Access::Public),
];

=== wire src/routes.rs @ samples: route mods
pub mod profile; // profile

=== wire src/routes.rs @ samples: routes
app = app.merge(profile::router()); // profile

=== wire src/routes.rs @ samples: paths
pub use super::profile::paths::*; // profile

=== wire src/routes.rs @ samples: route tables
// profile
profile::ROUTES,

=== create tests/app/pages/profile_test.rs
//! The profile page. Generated by `cargo offrails generate page profile`.

use offrails_app::routes::paths;

use crate::support::TestApp;

/// A page with a path parameter: not in the sitemap (APP: list the real ones in meta.rs).
#[tokio::test]
async fn profile_renders_publicly() {
    let app = TestApp::new().await;
    app.get(&paths::profile("example"))
        .await
        .assert_ok()
        .assert_contains("<title>Profile · ")
        .assert_text("Profile")
        .assert_text("example");
}
